items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...We were talking about him and Fass, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] He was a very, very fine musician.

ctx.x: Very, very good. He was excellent. And Skaggs, you say?
Skagg Leone, yeah. And what about him? We were talking about him and Fass, huh?
He was a very, very fine musician. And I think Fazzola was one of his... He was Fazzola's idol.
